claims.head: The Sabres’ edge in shot quality
claims.body: The Sabres are around the middle of the league for shot quality, and the Wild are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

claims.head: Where the Wild have the edge: shots from in close
claims.body: The Wild are one of the league’s best for shots from in close, and the Sabres are around the middle. That’s the biggest gap between these two, and it isn’t a big one. Shots from in close tend to be the more dangerous ones.

BUF.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Buffalo has home-ice advantage. For the Sabres, the difference could be keeping dangerous shots away.
